about: A monster outside any cell that kept a cell's sprite data (it left the cell, or its cell is on another floor) stopped loading the save with "<unknown_object>.slot_data not set before reading" in scr_set_mon_spr_data (Discord #33). Since 1.4.7 GNX restored the sprite data of every saved monster that had it; now only of a monster still in a cell.

steps.name: gnx_scn_mon_stale_spr
steps.why: three monsters outside cells get stale cell sprite data
the save loaded (a load error ends the run)
